job.job_description:
About the Role

We are seeking skilled Engineers (Junior and Senior levels) to join our growing Order Engineering team. You will be part of building and scaling our next-generation order processing platform, leveraging modern backend technologies and cloud-native infrastructure. Ideal candidates are passionate about clean code, scalable architecture, and solving real-world problems with technology.

Responsibilities

Junior Engineer:

Implement backend features and services using Python and FastAPI
Integrate with GraphQL/REST APIs and support frontend teams using TypeScript/React
Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews
Collaborate with DevOps to deploy services to AWS using Docker and Terraform
Debug, monitor, and optimize system performance with guidance
Learn and contribute to CI/CD (GitHub Actions) and Kubernetes/Argo CD workflows
Work with Git and follow agile development practices

Senior Engineer:

Architect and implement scalable services with Python, FastAPI, and GraphQL/REST
Drive API design, domain modeling, and system scalability for the order domain
Lead code reviews and mentor junior developers
Own CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and drive observability using OpenTelemetry
Optimize cloud deployments with AWS, Terraform, and Kubernetes/Argo CD
Collaborate cross-functionally with product, frontend, and QA teams
Champion engineering best practices and contribute to technical strategy

Tech Stack

Languages: Python (FastAPI), TypeScript, JavaScript (Node.js, React)
APIs: REST, GraphQL
Infra: AWS, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, Argo CD
CI/CD & Observability: GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry
Version Control: Git, GitHub

Requirements

Junior Engineer:

1-2 years experience in software development (internships count)
Strong foundation in Python; basic knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript, React, and Node.js
Familiarity with AWS, Docker, and Git
Willingness to learn Kubernetes/Argo CD, GitHub Actions, and cloud-native deployment

Senior Engineer:

5+ years of backend development experience with production systems
Proficient in Python and modern API development (FastAPI, REST/GraphQL)
Strong experience with cloud (preferably AWS), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)
Hands-on experience with CI/CD, Kubernetes, and observability
Ability to lead projects, mentor team members, and own delivery end-to-end

Nice to Have

Prior experience in order systems, e-commerce, or financial services
Contributions to open-source or tech blogs
Familiarity with event-driven architectures or message queues (e.g., Kafka, SQS)
